rationale: Karsin brings deep expertise in database systems, distributed query optimization, and analytical SQL engines from their Principal role at Oracle, while Aditya is actively working in data science with hands-on systems programming skills (C, Java, Python). Karsin's conviction that distributed query optimization is under-solved pairs well with Aditya's quantitative background and willingness to engage across low-level systems and backend development—they could explore how modern data systems challenges intersect with practical data science workflows.
intro_message: Karsin Kamakotti, meet Aditya Agrawal — Karsin's expertise in distributed query optimization and analytical SQL engines could inform Aditya's systems programming and data science work.
